claims.text: Previous agent research primarily focuses on training agents with limited knowledge within isolated environments.
Training agents in isolated environments with limited knowledge diverges from human learning processes.
Large language models acquire potential for human-level intelligence through the acquisition of vast Web knowledge.
The authors propose a unified framework for constructing LLM-based autonomous agents that encompasses prior work.

evidence.description: Previous research often focuses on training agents with limited knowledge within isolated environments
which diverges significantly from human learning processes, and makes the agents hard to achieve human-like decisions.
Recently, through the acquisition of vast amounts of Web knowledge, large language models (LLMs) have shown potential in human-level intelligence
We first discuss the construction of LLM-based autonomous agents, proposing a unified framework that encompasses much of previous work.

methodologies.name: Unified Framework for LLM-based Autonomous Agents
methodologies.description: A unified conceptual framework for the construction and evaluation of LLM-based autonomous agents.

limitations.text: Previous research focuses on training agents with limited knowledge within isolated environments, making human-like decisions difficult.

future_work.text: Addressing open challenges and exploring future research directions in LLM-based autonomous agents.
